name: The Laughing Fiend's Greeting

source.title: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege

disable: DC 44 Thievery check (legendary) to obscure or mar the magical runes set into the mural, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the mural

items.name: Tegresin's Greeting
items.text:
Trigger A creature capable of casting divine magic examines the mural

---

Effect The mural casts Weird (DC 43 Will save save) on all creatures in the gallery. A snarl fills the creatures' minds.

text: Subtle but deadly magical runes link this mural to Kharnas's master. Good- or neutral-aligned creatures who examine the mural witness the castle's drawbridge silently descend, revealing an endless darkness.
